ModMetaData.name: Local Error Fixes
ModMetaData.author: micro
ModMetaData.description:
Local XML patch mod that suppresses startup/log errors from workshop mods without editing the workshop files directly.
Reconstructed 2026-07-05 from the recovered project spec after the original (Windows) copy was lost. Each Patches/FixN_*.xml is self-contained and wrapped so failures are silent (success=Always / PatchOperationFindMod). MUST load LAST, after every other mod (enforce placement in RimSort).
